extracted.name: Gobi Manchurian
extracted.description: It's authentic indian street food made of cauliflower
ingredient_lines: You can use turmeric instead of food coloring it's healthy
instruction_lines: Take a bowl and mix corn and all purpose flour with pinch salt,black pepper,turmeric,red Chilli powder,garam masala and chaat masala
Now let mix whole mixture by adding water gradually make a thick mixture and add cauliflower florets.let it rest for 5 minutes
Make oil hot and start frying marinated cauliflower at low flame so it can cooked from inside too
Now take a pan and make little bit oil hot and add onion and capsicum and pinch of all spices with ketchup and soy sauce and vinegar
Let it cook 5minutes and add fried cauliflower just mix well and garnish with green onion.enjoy delicious street food. It's so simple but it looks tricky
